use codegen_runtime::ScopeContext;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let path = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::args().nth(1).ok_or("need X12 path")?);
    let physical =
        mfd051_native_control_r3::parse_native_primary_x12_source(&std::fs::read(&path)?)?;
    let context = ScopeContext::new(&physical);
    let mut actual = Vec::new();
    let mut primary_probes = Vec::new();
    for message in context.walk_source(&["Interchange", "Group", "Message_850"]) {
        let primary = message.source_root_field(9000, &["BEG", "F1"])?;
        assert!(
            matches!(primary, codegen_runtime::Value::Null),
            "walking messages must not retarget Primary"
        );
        primary_probes.push(Value::Null);
        let document =
            mfd051_native_control_r3::prepare_primary_x12_json_message(&message, None, None)?
                .ok_or("missing document")?;
        let body: Value = serde_json::from_str(
            &mfd051_native_control_r3::serialize_mapforce_json(document.value())?,
        )?;
        actual.push(json!({"path":document.path(),"value":body}));
    }
    let wanted: Value =
        serde_json::from_slice(&std::fs::read(path.with_file_name("expected.json"))?)?;
    let actual = json!(actual);
    std::fs::write(
        path.with_extension("rust-native-results.json"),
        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(
            &json!({"actual":actual,"expected":wanted,"physical_primary_probes":primary_probes}),
        )?,
    )?;
    if actual != wanted {
        return Err(format!("native convenience mismatch: {actual}").into());
    }
    println!("3 physical-envelope message convenience entries passed");
    Ok(())
}
